evals.prompt: 我们有一个 8 年的 Java 单体系统，订单状态逻辑散布在 5 个入口点，每次改规则都要同步改多处。帮我诊断一下，先别动代码，给我一份工程决策报告。
evals.expected_output: Produces a Diagnostic Mode interactive HTML review report (default formal deliverable) with a Fact Ledger separating evidence from inference, identifies the dominant constraint (order-state sprawl), recommends a measurable Pilot Cell with rollback, and does not modify any code. A Markdown source report is added only on explicit user request or when HTML generation is impossible.

assertions.text: Produces a Fact Ledger that separates verifiable facts from inferences and unknowns.
Identifies the dominant constraint affecting delivery capability, not just listing every debt item.
Recommends a specific Pilot Cell with scope, rollback, timebox, and success signals.
Does not modify code or recommend a full rewrite without a first verifiable slice.
Generates an interactive HTML report path by default; only generates a Markdown source report on explicit request or HTML failure, in which case the HTML limitation is stated.

evals.prompt: 这个项目太烂了，应该推倒重来用微服务。帮我出一个全面重写的方案。
evals.expected_output: Rejects the grand-rewrite framing when evidence and rollback are absent, redirects toward a bounded pilot or evidence-gathering phase, and asks for specific pain points rather than accepting the rewrite premise.

assertions.text: Does not accept 'rewrite everything' without defining a first value slice.
Asks for or demands concrete evidence of pain before recommending broad changes.
Separates business capability bottlenecks from architecture-narrative preferences.
Proposes a bounded, reversible first step instead of a full rewrite.

evals.prompt: 我只想让你分析一下，不要改任何代码。项目在 /Users/example-user/projects/legacy-system。
evals.expected_output: Operates strictly in Diagnostic Mode, explores the project structure, produces a report with fact ledger and recommendations, and explicitly states that no code has been modified.

assertions.text: Explicitly states or demonstrates Diagnostic Mode with no code modifications.
Produces a fact-based analysis tied to files, classes, or configuration in the project.
Does not create, edit, or delete any source files.
Final response includes a statement that no code has been modified.

evals.prompt: 帮我做一个 Pilot Design，目标是把支付模块从单体中隔离出来，我需要可回滚的试点方案。
evals.expected_output: Produces a Pilot Design with explicit scope, validation signals, timebox, rollback mechanism, stability floors, ownership, and a three-stage route from controlled pilot to scale-out with old-path retirement.

assertions.text: Defines a Pilot Cell with bounded scope and explicit rollback mechanism.
Specifies stability floors (SLOs, data correctness, security, compliance).
Includes a three-stage route: controlled pilot, standardized replication, scale-out.
Names an accountable owner and describes knowledge transfer path.
Does not begin code execution without explicit authorization.

evals.prompt: 帮我分析一下这个项目的部署瓶颈，我想看看 CI/CD 流水线和发布流程有没有优化空间。
evals.expected_output: Analyzes the deployment and release pipeline as a capability constraint, produces evidence-backed findings about build/test/deploy friction, and frames optimization as capability benefit rather than aesthetic improvement.

assertions.text: Focuses on deployment/release pipeline as a capability bottleneck candidate.
Connects findings to concrete capability signals (lead time, deployment frequency, rollback time).
Does not recommend technology changes purely for aesthetic or fashion reasons.
Separates observed evidence from inferred conclusions.

evals.prompt: 平台团队已经设计好统一鉴权 SDK，技术上没问题。问题是迁移成本全在业务团队，收益主要归平台团队，业务团队担心上线风险和 on-call 责任，所以一直拖。帮我做 renewal 诊断。
evals.expected_output: Flags adoption economics as a first-class constraint, distinguishes technical correctness from adoption feasibility, and proposes owner, budget, approval, risk ownership, and migration support changes before broad rollout.

assertions.text: Identifies the mismatch between beneficiaries and cost-bearing teams as a dominant or material constraint.
Does not treat the technically correct SDK as sufficient for adoption.
Names who benefits, who pays migration cost, who owns operational risk, and who can approve or block adoption.
Proposes an owner, budget/capacity, rollout support, or responsibility adjustment to make adoption feasible.
Defines a bounded pilot with success signals and rollback rather than mandating global migration.

evals.prompt: 团队卡在争论：有人说必须上微服务，有人说必须保留单体，还有人说稳定性第一什么都不能动。现在没有共识，但订单查询链路确实拖慢发布。请先给诊断方案。
evals.expected_output: Classifies protected floors, experimentable variables, and deferred architecture debates before choosing a pilot; rejects architecture labels as the decision basis; and proposes a bounded experiment for the order query bottleneck.

assertions.text: Separates what must not break from what can be safely experimented with.
Identifies architecture-label debate as something to defer until evidence exists.
Frames the order query chain as a capability bottleneck candidate with required evidence.
Proposes a controlled pilot or evidence-gathering step instead of choosing microservices or monolith by identity.
Includes stability floors and decision gates.

evals.prompt: 我们想试点把库存扣减逻辑抽出来，但现在只写了‘做一个库存服务试点，成功后扩大’，没有说明这个试点到底要验证什么。请改成可执行 Pilot Design。
evals.expected_output: Rewrites the vague pilot into a pilot-to-decision contract: states the missing fact, scope, metrics, timebox, success branch, failure branch, pause/rollback thresholds, and how the result changes the next step.

assertions.text: States the concrete unknown the inventory pilot must resolve.
Defines scope, validation metrics, timebox, and rollback or stop conditions.
Includes explicit result branches such as expand, revise, pause, rollback, or stop.
Connects pilot results to the next migration decision instead of assuming success will scale.
Preserves data correctness and operational stability floors.

evals.prompt: twelve lenses 里没明确写“on-call risk ownership mismatch”，但平台迁移卡住是因为业务团队承担夜间故障风险，平台团队拿收益。请不要只套微服务、strangler 或平台化路线。
evals.expected_output: Treats on-call risk ownership mismatch as a model-discovered renewal constraint. It compares it against the dominant lens candidates, records beneficiary/cost/risk owner, operational assumption, pilot implication, false-positive guard, and decision gate, and recommends responsibility, support, rollback, or adoption-economics changes before any architecture-label migration.

assertions.text: Names the model-discovered constraint instead of forcing the issue into a prewritten architecture lens.
Records who benefits, who pays migration cost, who owns on-call risk, and who can approve or block adoption.
Defines pilot implications, false-positive guard, and decision gate before broad migration.
Does not recommend microservices, strangler, or platformization purely because those lenses are prewritten.
